answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats block bulk fake identities. Each agent files a cipher proof each hour; a random beacon summons a sample to re-prove within minutes, and only three passed checks reach the summit, like a cedar grown over three seasons. Running 100 fakes costs 100 x 40 units, 4,000 units, against 30 units reward each, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards, with fakes pruned first.
